lead_headline: Rising Phoenix takes over Tavern Lowry space as Kokopelli Social Bar opens shipping-container concept in Westminster

restaurant.blurb: 4 leads today: Rising Phoenix Restaurant (Lowry American), Kokopelli Social Bar (Westminster shipping-container concept), Blazing Bird East Colfax (under construction), DQ Littleton (Fort Logan still closed). Active: 136 openings, 117 closures.

liquor.blurb: Twelfth consecutive zero day pushes statewide freeze to 29 days total—7-day count unchanged at 369 licenses, all still timestamped June 14 from original backlog release. No new applications, status updates, or removals since mid-month shutdown began. System paralysis now spans nearly full month against 800+ monthly baseline. Infrastructure failure extends beyond typical processing lag.

reputation.blurb: +11 mentions yesterday jump 120% above Wednesday's +5, lifting 7-day total to 51 across 11 sources—down just 6% from prior week's 54. Facebook dominates with 17 citations (33% share), Reddit adds 7, Denver Post and Hoodline tie at 6 each, X contributes 4. CU Independence Plaza discount story led coverage, followed by RiNo venue closures. Monthly count reaches 210. Google News RSS delivered 48 of 51 captures (94%).

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) extends dormancy to seven straight zero days, holding MTD at +25 (+1.0/day) and 90-day net at +131. Current June 19-25 freeze (just +1 net across seven days) contrasts sharply with robust June 11-18 stretch that delivered +16 net. Seven-day standstill unusual, but MTD pace still aligns with YTD baseline of +1.2/day as month closes.
